svg.text: internal junctions are named for what they join
U<ref>_<PIN> node at that IC pin e.g. UIVOA_VINP
R<stem>_M midpoint of a series pair e.g. RBALTA_M
R<stem>_<nm> tap between R<stem>n/m e.g. RV1D_01
all others are explicit design nets
identity per docs/magnetics.md (turns, gap, litz, acceptance lines live there)
D3 T1-T3: 3x E70/33/32 per section, 6:6:6 (D3-50: Ae x1.5 -> N x2/3, 108mT unchanged), Lm 63uH +/-7%
total Lr = trim + measured xfmr leakage (bins COMPENSATE leakage spread); Cr at TANK sections
50 kW DCDC board 2of2 - 3-phase LLC (1x air cells)
